levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عمر بن ميسرة

notes: Branches meet at Ibn Awn; «- المعنى واحد -» is an editor gloss and is left out
«حدثني أبي» is a relation link; the text does not name him
«وزعموا أنها كانت تدخل» is an unnamed hearsay remark about a scene, not a transmitter, left out
The last link is Aisha as «أم المؤمنين» (second occurrence: the one who speaks, not the place «تدخل على أم المؤمنين»)
